facts.text: A failure mode of a project is one specific way the project could fail to deliver what it promised; an early warning sign is an observable symptom that appears while there is still time to act.
facts.quote: a failure mode of a project is one specific way the project could fail to deliver what it promised, and an early warning sign is an observable symptom that appears while there is still time to act.

facts.text: Project failure modes are listed with their cause, first visible sign, risk-reducing action and seriousness.
facts.quote: Project failure modes are listed the way an engineer lists component failures: cause, first visible sign, the action that reduces it, and seriousness.

facts.text: The project failure-mode table rates a failure as Critical if it would by itself defeat the central claim or create a new hazard, High if it would force a major scope or schedule change, and Medium if it is recoverable with cost.
facts.quote: Critical (would by itself defeat the central claim or create a new hazard), High (would force a major scope or schedule change) or Medium (recoverable with cost)

facts.text: A Critical project failure mode is a toolchain that never becomes credible; early warning signs are huge virtual test counts without simulator-to-real residuals and no agreed correlation metrics by the first quarter of 2027.
facts.quote: The toolchain never becomes credible: huge virtual test counts without simulator-to-real residuals, no agreed correlation metrics by the first quarter of 2027.

facts.text: A Critical project failure mode is synthetic sensors reproducing appearance but not physics; early warning signs are good virtual metrics but field failures clustered by rain, dust, night or glare.
facts.quote: Synthetic sensors reproduce appearance but not physics: good virtual metrics but field failures clustered by rain, dust, night or glare.

facts.text: A Critical project failure mode is false braking on grades, with loads and at trailers; early warning signs are nuisance events in shadow mode and operators asking for an off-switch.
facts.quote: False braking on grades, with loads and at trailers: nuisance events in shadow mode, operators asking for an off-switch.

facts.text: A Critical project failure mode is machine dynamics models that do not generalize; the early warning sign is models being retuned after every physical test.
facts.quote: Machine dynamics that do not generalize: models retuned after every physical test.

facts.text: A Critical project failure mode is requirements debate consuming the four months; early warning signs are hazard analysis, performance levels or pass or fail metrics still being “to be decided” in 2027.
facts.quote: Requirements debate consuming the four months: hazard analysis, performance levels or pass or fail metrics still "to be decided" in 2027.

facts.text: A Critical project failure mode is supplier data arriving late or being legally unusable; early warning signs are brake maps or licensing still under negotiation near prototype delivery.
facts.quote: Supplier data late or legally unusable: brake maps or licensing still under negotiation near prototype delivery.

facts.text: A Critical project failure mode is the function being overfitted to the simulator; the early warning sign is improving virtual metrics while held-out real performance stalls.
facts.quote: The function overfitted to the simulator: virtual metrics improving while held-out real performance stalls.

facts.text: A Critical project failure mode is late rejection of virtual evidence; the early warning sign is reviewers seeing the credibility argument for the first time near launch.
facts.quote: Late rejection of virtual evidence: reviewers seeing the credibility argument for the first time near launch

facts.text: The overriding program-level warning sign is that by the first half of 2027 the team still cannot produce one short, auditable chain of evidence for a single representative requirement.
facts.quote: by the first half of 2027 the team still cannot produce one short, auditable chain of evidence for a single representative requirement

facts.text: The planning recommendation is that every risk in the register carry an early warning or signpost.
facts.quote: The planning chapter asks that every risk in the register carry an early warning or signpost [Chapter 12].

facts.text: Specific, dated project warning signs allow a manager without engineering training to check risks in a meeting and act before the deadline makes action impossible.
facts.quote: The signs are specific and dated, so a manager without engineering training can check them in a meeting and act before the deadline makes action impossible.
